cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(NOT SDK_PATH)
    get_filename_component(SDK_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../w803_sdk/wm_iot_sdk" ABSOLUTE)
endif()
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
add_compile_definitions(INCLUDE_uxTaskGetStackHighWaterMark=1)
include(${SDK_PATH}/tools/cmake/project.cmake)
set(PROJECT_NAME w803_link)
project(${PROJECT_NAME})
# WM SDK v2.4-rc enumerates component sources before generating device_table.
# Bind the generated file explicitly after generation, including a fresh build.
if(NOT CONFIG_DT_USE_C_STYLE_CONF)
    set(_wm_generated_dt "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/device_table/wm_dt_hw.c")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${_wm_generated_dt}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Generated device table is missing: ${_wm_generated_dt}")
    endif()
    get_target_property(_wm_dt_sources wm_dt SOURCES)
    list(FIND _wm_dt_sources "${_wm_generated_dt}" _wm_dt_source_index)
    if(_wm_dt_source_index EQUAL -1)
        target_sources(wm_dt PRIVATE "${_wm_generated_dt}")
    endif()
endif()
set(CMAKE_C_LINK_EXECUTABLE "<CMAKE_C_COMPILER> ${CMAKE_C_LINK_FLAGS} <OBJECTS> -o <TARGET> <LINK_LIBRARIES>")
target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME}.elf m)
